[batch narration moved out of reading 2026-09-02] CyrusOne is a large scale data center provider headquartered in Dallas, Texas. In 2016 CyrusOne purchased the Chicago Mercantile Exchanges original Aurora, Illinois data center from CME Group for roughly 130 million dollars, with CME Group continuing to operate its Globex matching engine on site under a 15 year lease. In November 2021, KKR and Global Infrastructure Partners agreed to acquire CyrusOne in an approximately 15 billion dollar deal, taking the company private, and that acquisition closed in 2022. CyrusOne has operated as a privately held company since, a company level ownership fact this registry had not previously recorded with a citable source. This specific row, San Antonio IV, is inferred to match this operators own SAT4 site code by the same sequential naming logic applied to the San Antonio III row above, corroborated by the operators own current locations page, fetched fresh this session, grouping SAT2 through SAT4 together as one named Data Center Campus. A datacentermap listing dedicated to SAT4, fetched fresh this session, gives 9655 Raba Drive, San Antonio, Texas 78251 as the street address, a distinct street from the SAT2 and SAT3 buildings on the same campus.
